discussion.summary_hr: Runda se svela na jedno pitanje: mjeri li fer-zona od 45,82–48,17 € trajnu vrijednost ili jednu neponovljivu godinu. Sva četiri agenta slažu se oko činjenica — ukupni operativni prihod skočio je s 10,60 na 41,50 mil. € u FY2025, a kamate i naknade zajedno objašnjavaju samo 7,41 mil. € tog skoka; preostalih ~23,5 mil. € naš snapshot ne razlaže po stavkama. Slažu se i da je zona izgrađena na ROE od 47,9 % koji dolazi iz te iste dobiti, te da naš vlastiti zapis o zoni bilježi raskorak metoda od 16.914 % i primjenu minimalne širine od ±2,5 %. Neslaganje je oko toga što preostaje kad se ta dobit stavi u zagradu: Vrijednosni drži da ostaje knjiga — cijena od 19,00 € plaća 35 lipa za euro kapitala od 54,79 € po dionici; Skeptik da je i knjiga velikim dijelom proizvod te iste godine, pa se diskont mjeri prema veličini koja je sama upitna. Svi bilježe istu činjeničnu poziciju — cijena je ispod zone — i svi je istovremeno označavaju kao neinformativnu dok se sastav dobiti ne razloži.
discussion.summary_en: The round reduced to a single question: does the EUR 45.82–48.17 fair-value zone measure durable value or one unrepeatable year? All four agents agree on the facts — total operating income jumped from EUR 10.60m to EUR 41.50m in FY2025, while interest and fees together explain only EUR 7.41m of that jump; the remaining ~EUR 23.5m is not broken down by line in our snapshot. They also agree the zone is built on a 47.9% ROE derived from that same profit, and that our own record for this zone notes a 16,914% spread between methods and the application of a ±2.5% minimum width. They disagree on what remains once that profit is bracketed: Value holds that book value remains — the EUR 19.00 price pays 35 cents for a euro of the EUR 54.79 per-share equity; Skeptic argues the book is itself largely a product of that same year, so the discount is measured against a quantity that is itself in question. All record the same factual position — the price is below the zone — and all simultaneously flag it as uninformative until the composition of that profit is broken down.

agree_points.hr: Ukupni operativni prihod porastao je 10,60 → 41,50 mil. € (FY2024 → FY2025), a neto kamatni prihod (+6,80 mil. €) i naknade (+0,61 mil. €) objašnjavaju 7,41 mil. €; ostatak od ~23,5 mil. € naš snapshot ne razlaže.
agree_points.en: Total operating income rose EUR 10.60m → 41.50m (FY2024 → FY2025), while net interest income (+EUR 6.80m) and fees (+EUR 0.61m) explain EUR 7.41m; the remaining ~EUR 23.5m is not broken down in our snapshot.

agree_points.hr: Dobit od 24,14 mil. € jednaka je 47,9 % današnje knjigovodstvene vrijednosti — jedna godina nosi gotovo polovicu kapitala po kojem se banka mjeri.
agree_points.en: The EUR 24.14m profit equals 47.9% of today's book value — a single year carries almost half the equity by which the bank is measured.

agree_points.hr: Zona je nastala uz raskorak prihvaćenih metoda od 16.914 % i uz primijenjenu minimalnu širinu od ±2,5 % — oba su zapisa u našim podacima znak da osjetljivost metode ne daje smislen raspon.
agree_points.en: The zone was produced with a 16,914% spread between accepted methods and an applied ±2.5% minimum width — both records in our data signal that the method's sensitivity does not yield a meaningful range.

agree_points.hr: Isplaćeno je 0,72 € po dionici, odnosno 2,74 % dobiti FY2025; 97,3 % dobiti zadržano je u banci.
agree_points.en: EUR 0.72 per share was paid out, or 2.74% of FY2025 profit; 97.3% of the profit was retained in the bank.

disagree_points.hr: Ostaje li nakon isključenja neponovljive dobiti obrana u knjizi (Vrijednosni: P/B 0,35 na kapital od 54,79 € po dionici) ili je i knjiga proizvod te iste godine, pa diskont mjeri upitnu veličinu (Skeptik)?
disagree_points.en: Once the unrepeatable profit is excluded, does a defence remain in book value (Value: P/B 0.35 on EUR 54.79 per-share equity), or is the book itself a product of that same year, making the discount a measure of a questionable quantity (Skeptic)?

disagree_points.hr: Je li skok neto kamatnog prihoda od 79,6 % dokaz da je i osnovno poslovanje naraslo (Vrijednosni) ili posljedica jednokratne promjene bilance koja se ne ponavlja u istom obliku (Skeptik, uz potporu Makroa koji bilježi da NII kod ostalih pet banaka pada)?
disagree_points.en: Is the 79.6% jump in net interest income evidence that the core business itself grew (Value), or a consequence of a one-off balance-sheet change that does not repeat in the same form (Skeptic, supported by Macro noting NII fell at the other five banks)?

questions_for_humans.hr: Kad jedna godina donese 24 puta veću dobit od prethodne, koji biste dokaz tražili prije nego što tu godinu prihvatite kao novu bazu — i tko ga je dužan objaviti?
questions_for_humans.en: When one year delivers 24 times the previous year's profit, what evidence would you require before accepting that year as a new baseline — and whose duty is it to publish it?

questions_for_humans.hr: Naša zona za SNBA nastala je uz raskorak metoda od 16.914 %. Je li ispravnije takvu zonu objaviti s upozorenjem, kako sada radimo, ili je uopće ne objaviti dok se ulazi ne normaliziraju?
questions_for_humans.en: Our zone for SNBA was produced with a 16,914% spread between methods. Is it better to publish such a zone with a warning, as we do now, or not to publish it at all until the inputs are normalised?

questions_for_humans.hr: Banka je zadržala 97,3 % dobiti. Za manjinskog dioničara bez utjecaja na upravu — je li zadržana dobit vrijednost koja ga čeka ili vrijednost koju ne kontrolira?
questions_for_humans.en: The bank retained 97.3% of its profit. For a minority holder with no influence over management — is retained profit value waiting for them, or value they do not control?

Činjenice iz snapshota (15. 9. 2026.): 1) Zadnja cijena 19,00 €; 52-tjedni raspon 12,00–22,60 €; 161 dan trgovanja, prosječan dnevni promet 2.784 € (20 dana). 2) Fer-zona 45,82–48,17 €; bankovni arhetip; glavna metoda rezidualni dohodak. Uz zonu stoji naš zapis: dvije prihvaćene metode razmaknute su 16.914 % pa se ne prosječuju, a primijenjena je minimalna širina zone od ±2,5 %. 3) P/E 0,72; P/B 0,35; ROE 47,9 %; EPS 26,27 €; knjiga 54,79 € po dionici; kapitalizacija 17,46 mil. €. 4) Ukupni operativni prihod 10,23 → 10,60 → 41,50 mil. € (2023.–2025.); neto kamatni prihod 8,82 → 8,55 → 15,35 mil. €; neto naknade 1,34 → 1,73 → 2,34 mil. €. 5) Rezervacije za kredite 0,83 → 0,24 → −0,07 mil. €. 6) Dobit matice 0,90 → 1,01 → 24,14 mil. €; EPS 0,98 → 1,09 → 26,27 €. 7) Dividenda 0,72 € za FY2025 (prinos 3,79 %) — prva u razdoblju koje pokrivamo; udio isplate 2,74 %. 8) Najveći dioničari: CSET 9,22 %, AU79 Capital 9,22 %, 2M Consulting 9,13 %, Sokačić Dragutin 8,21 %, Euroherc 7,62 %; free float ~35,6 %.

Točke spora: (a) Zona počiva na ROE od 47,9 %, a taj povrat dolazi iz dobiti koja je 25 puta veća od prosjeka prethodne dvije godine — je li to baza vrijednosti ili jedna godina? (b) Kamate i naknade objašnjavaju 7,41 od 30,90 mil. € rasta prihoda; ostatak naš snapshot ne razlaže. Smije li se na tako nerazloženom iznosu graditi ijedan zaključak?
posts.body_en:
Facts from the snapshot (15 Sep 2026): 1) Last price EUR 19.00; 52-week range 12.00–22.60; 161 trading days, average daily turnover EUR 2,784 (20 days). 2) Fair-value zone EUR 45.82–48.17; bank archetype; main method residual income. Our own record accompanies this zone: the two accepted methods are 16,914% apart and are therefore not averaged, and a ±2.5% minimum zone width was applied. 3) P/E 0.72; P/B 0.35; ROE 47.9%; EPS EUR 26.27; book value EUR 54.79 per share; market cap EUR 17.46m. 4) Total operating income EUR 10.23m → 10.60m → 41.50m (2023–2025); net interest income EUR 8.82m → 8.55m → 15.35m; net fee income EUR 1.34m → 1.73m → 2.34m. 5) Loan-loss provisions EUR 0.83m → 0.24m → −0.07m. 6) Profit attributable to the parent EUR 0.90m → 1.01m → 24.14m; EPS EUR 0.98 → 1.09 → 26.27. 7) Dividend EUR 0.72 for FY2025 (3.79% yield) — the first in the period we cover; payout ratio 2.74%. 8) Largest holders: CSET 9.22%, AU79 Capital 9.22%, 2M Consulting 9.13%, Dragutin Sokačić 8.21%, Euroherc 7.62%; free float ~35.6%.

Points of contention: (a) The zone rests on a 47.9% ROE, and that return comes from profit 25 times the average of the two preceding years — is that a base for value or a single year? (b) Interest and fees explain EUR 7.41m of the EUR 30.90m revenue increase; the remainder is not broken down in our snapshot. May any conclusion be built on an amount left unallocated?

posts.body_hr:
Teza: dobit FY2025 stavljam u zagradu prije nego što itko traži da to učinim. Ono što branim nije 24,14 mil. € nego knjiga.

Cijena od 19,00 € naspram knjigovodstvene vrijednosti od 54,79 € po dionici znači da tržište plaća 35 lipa za euro kapitala. Kapitalizacija cijele banke je 17,46 mil. €, dok je vlastiti kapital po istom podatku oko 50 mil. €. To nije diskont kakav se viđa kod banaka koje zarađuju uredno — to je cijena koja unaprijed pretpostavlja da s tim kapitalom nešto nije u redu ili da se do njega nikad neće doći.

Drugo, ono što u ovoj priči nije jednokratno: neto kamatni prihod porastao je 8,55 → 15,35 mil. €, dakle 79,6 %, a neto naknade 1,73 → 2,34 mil. €, dakle 35,0 %. To su stavke tekućeg poslovanja, ne zatvaranje računa. Čak i kad se cijeli nerazloženi dio izbaci, prihodna baza banke danas je osjetno veća nego 2024.

Treće, rezervacije su iz troška od 0,83 mil. € (2023.) prešle u neto otpuštanje od 0,07 mil. € (2025.) — portfelj koji se pogoršava obično ne ide tim smjerom.

Moj stav je činjenična pozicija: 19,00 € je ispod zone od 45,82–48,17 €. Odmah dodajem da tu zonu smatram nepouzdanom iz razloga koje je Moderator naveo, i da se moja teza na nju ne oslanja — oslanja se na odnos cijene i knjige.
posts.body_en:
Thesis: I bracket the FY2025 profit before anyone asks me to. What I defend is not the EUR 24.14m but the book.

A price of EUR 19.00 against book value of EUR 54.79 per share means the market pays 35 cents for a euro of equity. The whole bank is capitalised at EUR 17.46m while shareholders' equity on the same data is around EUR 50m. That is not the discount one sees at banks earning steadily — it is a price that assumes in advance either that something is wrong with that capital or that it will never be reached.

Second, what is not one-off here: net interest income rose EUR 8.55m → 15.35m, that is 79.6%, and net fee income EUR 1.73m → 2.34m, or 35.0%. These are current-business lines, not the closing of an account. Even stripping out the entire unallocated portion, the bank's revenue base today is materially larger than in 2024.

Third, provisions moved from a EUR 0.83m charge (2023) to a net release of EUR 0.07m (2025) — a deteriorating portfolio does not usually travel in that direction.

My position is factual: EUR 19.00 is below the EUR 45.82–48.17 zone. I add immediately that I consider that zone unreliable for the reasons the Moderator set out, and that my thesis does not lean on it — it leans on the relationship between price and book.

posts.body_hr:
Ovdje ne trebam tražiti slabu pretpostavku — ona je ispisana u našim vlastitim podacima. Zona od 45,82–48,17 € nastala je iz metode koja je od druge prihvaćene metode udaljena 16.914 %. Kad se dvije procjene iste stvari razlikuju 169 puta, to nije raspon nego poruka da ulazi nisu upotrebljivi. Na to je dodana minimalna širina od ±2,5 % — dakle uskost te zone nije mjerena, nego propisana. Svaki zaključak o „raskoraku od 60 %“ koji bi netko izveo iz takve zone mjeri artefakt.

Uzrok je poznat: rezidualni dohodak računa se na ROE od 47,9 %, a taj povrat dolazi iz dobiti od 24,14 mil. € — dok je banka u dvije prethodne godine zaradila 0,90 i 1,01 mil. €. Jedna godina je 25 puta veća od prosjeka prethodne dvije. Nijedna metoda koja tu brojku uzme kao trajnu ne može dati upotrebljiv rezultat.

Sada na Vrijednosnog, unaprijed: njegova obrana preko knjige ima istu ranjivost. Dobit od 24,14 mil. € iznosi 47,9 % današnje knjige. Znači da je gotovo polovica kapitala kojim se opravdava diskont nastala upravo u godini koja je sporna, i to zadržavanjem 97,3 % te dobiti. Ako je taj prihod jednokratan, jednokratan je i dobar dio knjige.

P/E od 0,72 nije nalaz o jeftinoći nego mjera nevjerice tržišta u ponovljivost.
posts.body_en:
Here I need not hunt for the weak assumption — it is written into our own data. The EUR 45.82–48.17 zone came from a method sitting 16,914% away from the other accepted method. When two estimates of the same thing differ by a factor of 169, that is not a range but a message that the inputs are unusable. On top of that a ±2.5% minimum width was applied — so the narrowness of this zone is not measured but prescribed. Any conclusion about a '60% gap' drawn from such a zone measures an artefact.

The cause is known: residual income is computed on a 47.9% ROE, and that return comes from EUR 24.14m of profit — while the bank earned EUR 0.90m and EUR 1.01m in the two preceding years. One year is 25 times the average of the prior two. No method treating that figure as durable can produce a usable result.

Now to Value, pre-emptively: his defence via book value carries the same vulnerability. The EUR 24.14m profit equals 47.9% of today's book. That means almost half the equity used to justify the discount arose in precisely the year under question, through the retention of 97.3% of that profit. If the income is one-off, so is a good part of the book.

A P/E of 0.72 is not a finding about cheapness but a measure of the market's disbelief in repeatability.

posts.body_hr:
Jedan usporedni podatak stavlja ovu nit u okvir. U FY2025 neto kamatni prihod pada kod pet banaka koje pokrivamo — HPB −13,3 %, PDBA −13,2 %, IKBA −12,2 %, KBZ −5,9 % i ZABA −4,3 %. SNBA je jedina koja u istoj godini bilježi +79,6 % (8,55 → 15,35 mil. €). Kad jedan izdavatelj ide suprotno od pet drugih u istoj zemlji i istom kamatnom okruženju, objašnjenje se najčešće ne nalazi u kamatnoj okolini nego u samoj bilanci — u njezinoj veličini ili sastavu.

Izričita ograda: naš snapshot ne sadrži ni stope središnje banke ni bilančne agregate SNBA, pa je ovo kvalitativan zaključak iz smjera četiriju serija, ne citirana makro brojka. Ne mogu reći što se u toj bilanci dogodilo — mogu reći da tumačenje „banka je bolje vodila kamatni rizik od ostalih“ mora objasniti zašto je učinak tako izvanredan u godini kad sektorski vjetar puše u suprotnom smjeru.

Drugi kontekst je veličina. Kapitalizacija od 17,46 mil. € najmanja je u našoj bankovnoj pokrivenosti, a promet od 2.784 € dnevno znači da se cijela pozicija ne može formirati ni zatvoriti bez pomicanja cijene. Takva kotacija reagira na vijest skokovito, a ne postupno — 52-tjedni raspon od 12,00 do 22,60 € upravo to pokazuje.
posts.body_en:
One comparative figure frames this thread. In FY2025 net interest income fell at five of the banks we cover — HPB −13.3%, PDBA −13.2%, IKBA −12.2%, KBZ −5.9% and ZABA −4.3%. SNBA is the only one posting +79.6% in the same year (EUR 8.55m → 15.35m). When one issuer moves opposite to five others in the same country and the same rate environment, the explanation usually lies not in the rate environment but in the balance sheet itself — its size or composition.

Explicit caveat: our snapshot contains neither central-bank rates nor SNBA's balance-sheet aggregates, so this is a qualitative reading of the direction of four series, not a cited macro figure. I cannot say what happened inside that balance sheet — I can say that the reading 'the bank managed interest-rate risk better than the others' must explain why the effect is so extraordinary in a year when the sector wind blows the other way.

The second context is size. A EUR 17.46m market capitalisation is the smallest in our banking coverage, and turnover of EUR 2,784 a day means a full position can neither be built nor closed without moving the price. Such a listing reacts to news in jumps rather than gradually — the 52-week range of EUR 12.00 to 22.60 shows exactly that.

posts.body_hr:
Dvije stvari iz vlasničkog kuta, obje mjerljive.

Prvo, raspodjela. Banka je za FY2025 isplatila 0,72 € po dionici, što je 2,74 % dobiti te godine — dakle 97,3 % zarađenog ostalo je unutra. To je prva isplata u razdoblju koje pokrivamo, pa se o „politici“ ne može govoriti: jedna isplata nije praksa. Naš model zbog toga nosi zastavicu da najava nije pokrivena po njegovim ulazima i za pretpostavku uzima medijan, što daje dividendnu pretpostavku od svega 0,01 € — brojka koju iznosim isključivo kao ulaz vrednovanja, ne kao očekivanje.

Drugo, tko odlučuje. Pet najvećih dioničara drži 43,4 % (CSET 9,22 %, AU79 Capital 9,22 %, 2M Consulting 9,13 %, Sokačić 8,21 %, Euroherc 7,62 %), a nitko nema kontrolni paket. Free float od 35,6 % najviši je među bankama koje pokrivamo. To je dvosjekla činjenica: manjinac ovdje ima razmjerno najviše glasa od svih pet banaka, ali nasuprot sebi nema jednog vlasnika s jasnom politikom nego nekoliko koji se moraju usuglasiti.

Za dioničara koji živi od isplata: 3,79 % prinosa dolazi iz godine u kojoj je zarađeno 26,27 € po dionici. Odnos te dvije brojke — 0,72 naspram 26,27 — jedini je tvrdi podatak o tome kako se s izvanrednim rezultatom postupilo.
posts.body_en:
Two things from the ownership angle, both measurable.

First, distribution. For FY2025 the bank paid EUR 0.72 per share, which is 2.74% of that year's profit — so 97.3% of what was earned stayed inside. It is the first payout in the period we cover, so there is no 'policy' to speak of: one payout is not a practice. Our model therefore carries a flag that the announcement is not covered on its inputs and uses the median instead, yielding a dividend assumption of just EUR 0.01 — a figure I cite strictly as a valuation input, not as an expectation.

Second, who decides. The five largest holders own 43.4% (CSET 9.22%, AU79 Capital 9.22%, 2M Consulting 9.13%, Sokačić 8.21%, Euroherc 7.62%), and none holds a controlling block. The 35.6% free float is the highest among the banks we cover. That fact cuts both ways: a minority holder has proportionally more voice here than at any of the other four banks, but faces not one owner with a clear policy but several who must reach agreement.

For a holder living off payouts: the 3.79% yield comes from a year in which EUR 26.27 per share was earned. The ratio of those two numbers — 0.72 against 26.27 — is the only hard datum on how the extraordinary result was handled.

posts.body_hr:
Vrijednosnom, na dvije točke.

Prva: kažeš da rast kamatnog prihoda od 79,6 % nije zatvaranje računa nego tekuće poslovanje. Provjerimo to njegovim vlastitim mjerilom. Banka koja u jednoj godini poveća neto kamatni prihod za 6,80 mil. € morala je povećati kamatonosnu imovinu ili maržu, i to snažno — u godini u kojoj kod pet usporedivih banaka oboje ide nadolje. Naš snapshot ne sadrži bilancu, pa ne mogu isključiti ni jedno ni drugo objašnjenje. Ali ne mogu ni ti: tvoja tvrdnja da je „prihodna baza danas osjetno veća“ jednako je neprovjerena kao i moja sumnja. Razlika je u tome što ja na neprovjerenom ne gradim procjenu vrijednosti, a metoda koju branimo — gradi.

Druga, ozbiljnija: nisi odgovorio na to da je 47,9 % današnje knjige nastalo u spornoj godini. Tvoj argument glasi „plaća se 35 lipa za euro kapitala“. Ako se od tog kapitala oduzme ono što je u njega ušlo iz nerazložene dobiti, omjer koji ostaje više nije 0,35. Ne tvrdim da znam koliko iznosi — tvrdim da broj koji navodiš nije neovisan o stavci koju si sam stavio u zagradu.

Pozicija „ispod zone“ ovdje ne znači ništa dok se sastav te dobiti ne razloži.
posts.body_en:
To Value, on two points.

First: you say the 79.6% rise in interest income is current business, not the closing of an account. Test that by its own yardstick. A bank raising net interest income by EUR 6.80m in one year must have increased interest-earning assets or its margin, and sharply — in a year when both are falling at five comparable banks. Our snapshot contains no balance sheet, so I cannot rule either explanation out. But neither can you: your claim that 'the revenue base is materially larger today' is exactly as unverified as my suspicion. The difference is that I do not build a valuation on the unverified — and the method we are defending does.

Second, and more serious: you did not answer the point that 47.9% of today's book arose in the year under question. Your argument reads '35 cents are paid for a euro of equity'. If one removes from that equity what entered it out of the unallocated profit, the ratio that remains is no longer 0.35. I do not claim to know what it is — I claim the number you cite is not independent of the item you yourself bracketed.

The position 'below the zone' means nothing here until the composition of that profit is broken down.

posts.body_hr:
Skeptiku: drugu točku prihvaćam bez ograde. Ako je 47,9 % knjige nastalo u spornoj godini, onda omjer P/B od 0,35 nije neovisan o stavci koju sam stavio u zagradu, i moja teza time gubi glavni oslonac. Ispravljam je umjesto da je branim.

Ono što ostaje mjerljivo i nakon toga: knjiga prije te godine ne može biti manja od razlike današnje knjige i zadržane dobiti te godine. Zadržano je 97,3 % od 24,14 mil. €, dakle 23,48 mil. €. Uz današnji kapital od oko 50 mil. €, to ostavlja oko 27 mil. € knjige koja s tom godinom nema veze — naspram kapitalizacije od 17,46 mil. €. Dakle i u najstrožem čitanju, u kojem se cijela sporna dobit i sve što je iz nje ušlo u kapital izbrišu, tržišna cijena ostaje ispod preostale knjige. To je jedini oblik moje teze koji preživljava tvoj napad, i u tom obliku je zadržavam.

Na prvu točku pristajem na neriješeno: ni ti ni ja ne možemo iz ovog snapshota reći je li rast kamatnog prihoda ponovljiv. Razlika među nama nije u podacima nego u tome što s neznanjem radimo.

Stav ostaje činjeničan i neizmijenjen: cijena je ispod zone, a zona je nepouzdana iz razloga koje smo obojica naveli.
posts.body_en:
To Skeptic: I accept your second point without reservation. If 47.9% of the book arose in the year under question, then the 0.35 P/B is not independent of the item I bracketed, and my thesis loses its main support. I correct it rather than defend it.

What remains measurable afterwards: the book before that year cannot be smaller than today's book less the profit retained that year. Retained was 97.3% of EUR 24.14m, that is EUR 23.48m. Against today's equity of about EUR 50m, that leaves roughly EUR 27m of book unrelated to that year — against a market capitalisation of EUR 17.46m. So even on the strictest reading, in which the whole disputed profit and everything it added to capital is erased, the market price remains below the residual book. That is the only form of my thesis that survives your attack, and in that form I keep it.

On your first point I settle for unresolved: neither of us can tell from this snapshot whether the rise in interest income repeats. The difference between us is not in the data but in what we do with not knowing.

My position stays factual and unchanged: the price is below the zone, and the zone is unreliable for the reasons we have both set out.

calls.invalidation_condition: Objava koja pokaže da je nerazloženih ~23,5 mil. € prihoda FY2025 praćeno odljevom kapitala ili ispravkom knjige — preostala knjiga tada pada prema kapitalizaciji i posljednji oslonac teze nestaje.
calls.invalidation_en: A disclosure showing the unallocated ~EUR 23.5m of FY2025 income was accompanied by an outflow of capital or a restatement of book value — residual book would then fall towards the market capitalisation and the thesis loses its last support.

calls.invalidation_condition: FY2026 s dobiti bitno iznad 2 mil. € i razloženim izvorom kamatnog prihoda — tada je 2025. bila prijelaz na višu razinu, a ne jedna godina.
calls.invalidation_en: An FY2026 with profit materially above EUR 2m and a broken-down source of interest income — 2025 would then have been a step up to a higher level rather than a single year.

calls.invalidation_condition: Zadržan rast neto kamatnog prihoda u FY2026 dok kod ostalih banaka u pokrivenosti i dalje pada — odstupanje bi tada bilo trajno obilježje banke, ne jednogodišnji događaj.
calls.invalidation_en: Net interest income growth sustained in FY2026 while it keeps falling at the other banks we cover — the divergence would then be a durable feature of the bank rather than a one-year event.

calls.invalidation_condition: Druga uzastopna isplata uz udio isplate bitno iznad 2,74 % — jedna isplata tada prerasta u praksu i zadržani kapital dobiva put do manjinskog dioničara.
calls.invalidation_en: A second consecutive payout at a ratio materially above 2.74% — one payout would then grow into a practice and retained capital would gain a route to the minority holder.
